title: Verdict-instrument optimality audit
count_basis: Producer fanout counts are scoped to receipts and ledgers read in this arm. They are not a global absence or all-history census. AU1/probe-outcome detector counts were treated as triage, not verdicts.

named_defects: silent cap default
cap-stopped row reused as convergence-like evidence
budget-censored negative
fanout_basis: CA1 static census found 89 cap-default sites, 83 silent cap-default sites, and 6 live/reopen-risk sites; NG1/OA1 show multiple cap-stopped rows entering negative or midpoint ledgers.
reopen_pressure: 6 live/reopen-risk sites plus any standing verdict that cites capped convergence as if semantic convergence was reached.
now_existing_cure: CapStopReceipt-style explicit cap flags
uncap ladder to semantic stop
do not promote cap-stopped negatives without a convergence receipt
routing: Reopen capped P0 rows before treating them as settled negatives; do not spend scorer on a row whose stop reason is still the old cap.

named_defects: float solve then Euclidean project-after
project-after seam
diagonal or incomplete metric
pose-null constraint applied after optimizing the wrong space
fanout_basis: SW1 ledger records 7 project-after/metric/rate seam rows, including 3 convert-to-solve-within decisions; DK1 found 5 lattice-native-solvable float-first source sites. This count mixes verdict chains and source sites and is used only for routing priority.
reopen_pressure: SW1 measured solve-within eta 0.3114071607 versus project-after eta 0.0940882598/0.0982514571 against eta_bar 0.1710048742 on the same n4 slice.
now_existing_cure: solve in the constraint/native subspace before projection
use DK1 lattice-native realization before scorer-backed promotion
price full interface loss where the receiver is still naive
routing: Highest practical reopen class: ET1/Q3/Q31/SQ1 rows that passed through this seam must be re-routed through solve-within plus lattice realization before any final negative.

named_defects: naive uniform scorer rounding
float-first nullspace delta then post-hoc integer rounding
receiver/composite-R leakage not optimized in integer lattice
fanout_basis: DK1 identified 5 lattice-native-solvable source sites; FD1/FD2 zero-accept, v19c finite-coordinate saturation, and PF3B E4-priced physical edge each depend on current receiver/integer realization quality.
reopen_pressure: DK1 CVP/Babai kept-set realizer reduced mean A(Dx) leakage from 0.07217925 to 0.007107145151 and real PoseNet leakage from 4.9131755e-09 to 6.4355234e-13 on the audited block sample.
now_existing_cure: DK1 CVP/Babai kept-set enumeration for pose-null blocks
integer-aware near-margin proposals
realized argmax validation in the training/proposal loop
routing: Do not call float-first rows exhausted until their integer receiver is the DK1 class or a stronger global integer solver; FD2 specifically says pose-null projection alone cannot manufacture seg descent.

named_defects: prefix subset used as population evidence
small effective-N prefix on pose axis
top-k subset gate used as kill/rank authority
aggregate n32 mixture hiding per-record sign
fanout_basis: NA2 regraded four post-hoc pose documents to prefix-scoped weak evidence; SQ1 pose caveat, LC1 aggregate PE3 labels, M5R top24 subset, and gate36/private-support style gates each need their denominator kept local.
reopen_pressure: Prefix pose subsets were later shown anti-conservative on the pose axis; LC1 killed PE3 target labels only at aggregate n32, not per-record trust/filter use.
now_existing_cure: seeded random n>=120 for pose-family retest if reopened
non-prefix evenly/stratified n32 only as advisory
per-record positive-net or trust gate before family-level routing
routing: Keep subset results as local filters unless the row has a fresh seeded denominator and no hidden top-k/routing gate.

named_defects: greedy-no-restart possible
finite represented-coordinate saturation
fixed order stopped after delegated question was answered
rank/proxy not equal to final joint score
fanout_basis: v19c saturation, M5R restricted master/top24, V12 vocabulary plateau, G1/greedy-MDL bounds from A1 memory, and PF3B fixed 52-probe order are the scoped rows found; not all are wrong, but several have not been rerun with a stronger compiler.
reopen_pressure: These rows often prove the current represented alphabet or current ordering is not enough; they do not prove the physical family or vocabulary is globally exhausted.
now_existing_cure: multi-start or exact-set compiler where affordable
amortized payload packing before rejecting a real edge
separate subset ranking from n600 admission
routing: Reopen only where a better compiler or packing objective now exists; do not relabel finite-menu saturation as global family death.

named_defects: one-shot linearization
smooth proxy descended while realized argmax did not flip
zero-accept window interpreted too broadly
fanout_basis: FD1 family-D GN/CG, FD2 pose-null disambiguation, and terminal-band discrete search lineage; FD2 narrowed the blocker to uint8 seg-realization rather than pose veto or proven locality failure.
reopen_pressure: FD2 measured no argmax flips at reduced scales and wrong-direction flips at full scale despite smooth-proxy descent; this is a stale instrument form, not a global descent-family kill.
now_existing_cure: integer-aware near-margin proposals
realized argmax validation in-loop
trained partition-to-pixel renderer before acceptance pricing
routing: Route through SPEC_tr1 or an integer-aware terminal finisher before reusing FD1 zero-accept as a family verdict.

named_defects: diagonal approximation
full MS4D or margin-Fisher metric refused/absent
metric not bound to byte home
fanout_basis: SW1 Arm M, SW1 metric-diagonal saliency row, MS4D full margin-Fisher refusal, and ET2/Arm-M style metric projectors are the scoped affected rows.
reopen_pressure: The diagonal metric was still below eta bar in SW1, while solve-within changed the verdict; full metric remains a priced-interface question, not a settled no-go.
now_existing_cure: solve-within first
price full Gram only after a rate/receiver home exists
do not infer diagonal failure to full metric family
routing: Medium priority unless a candidate has already cleared solve-within and is blocked only on metric quality.

fanout_basis: RL1, TZ1/SV2 style byte races, lossless coder rows, and q11 crop pricing are accepted as real serialized coder outputs when their receipts state byte-only scope.
reopen_pressure: No instrument-form reopen for byte pricing alone; reopen is only for missing receiver/scorer realization after a clean byte price.
now_existing_cure: compose with receiver proof before score claim
keep byte-only scope explicit
routing: Do not reopen the byte measurement; route the missing realization half separately.

fanout_basis: ET1/phase-field block16 offsets and DK1 kept-set enumeration are bounded local searches with explicit scope and no global optimality claim.
reopen_pressure: No direct reopen on the search form; only reopen if its input target or realization seam was naive.
now_existing_cure: keep bounded scope
carry parseback and scorer denominator forward
routing: Use as a clean local primitive inside higher-stakes ET1/Q3 reopens.

named_defects: detector count not adjudicated
headline/body mismatch risk
candidate count used as verdict risk
fanout_basis: AU1 correction index, probe_outcomes ledger, and negative verdict gates are useful recall surfaces but not sufficient as primary evidence without receipt adjudication.
reopen_pressure: OA1 explicitly warns detector counts are triage only.
now_existing_cure: receipt-level adjudication before ledger promotion
bounded source and denominator in each row
routing: Use for recall and fanout discovery only; do not create a reopen row from detector count alone.
